posts.caption: Back pain from standing rarely has much to do with a weak back. Knees locked straight, hips pushed forward, ribs leaning back, and suddenly only the small muscles in your lower back are holding you up. Three small changes make standing quiet again, and with Previa Health you can see on your phone in about two minutes, free, where your body freezes when you stand. Save this for the next concert or queue. #BackPain #Standing #Posture #Mobility #PreviaHealth

Leg tingles or goes slightly numb when you sit? Usually a glute muscle is pressing on the line that carries feeling down to your foot, so the flow gets cut short. Standing up every 30 minutes, crossing your ankle over the opposite knee and leaning forward, plus moving your foot and leg, all give it room again. Test it in about two minutes on your phone, free, with Previa Health. Which side is it for you? #sciatica #glutemuscle #tingling #sittingtoolong #PreviaHealth

Hip aching when you sleep on your side? Your top leg drifts forward and your hip is left hanging because the outer hip muscles did nothing all day while you sat. A pillow between your knees, side leg raises, and standing on one leg while you brush your teeth give them a job again. Test which hip is slacking with Previa Health in about two minutes on your phone, free. Save this for tonight. #SideSleeping #HipPain #HipMuscles #SleepPosition #PreviaHealth

Heel stinging for your first few steps in the morning? Your foot spends the night pointed down and stays short, so your first step pulls it long all at once, like biting into cold gum straight from the fridge. Pulling your foot toward you in bed, a calf stretch on the edge, and rolling the sole over a bottle before sleep give it its length back. Test it yourself with Previa Health in about two minutes on your phone, free. Save this for tomorrow morning. #MorningStiffness #HeelPain #FootHealth #Mobility #PreviaHealth

That chair twist can feel satisfying for a second, then show up again an hour later. Your body may be looking for the small turns your neck, ribcage and hips missed while you were facing one screen. Try this three-part reset before you force another twist. Follow Previa Health for the next body signal worth noticing. #DeskStiffness #BackMobility #RibMobility #OfficeHealth #PreviaHealth

You've never taken a real full breath. Not because something is wrong with your lungs — but because your body physically won't let you. When your upper back is stiff and your shoulders are rounded, your ribcage can't fully expand. So your body defaults to shallow chest breathing. That keeps your nervous system in a low-level stress state all day. The fix isn't breathing exercises. It's unlocking the ribcage first. Once the cage opens, everything changes — sleep, stress, energy, recovery. #breathing #mobility #posture #stressrelief
The Posture lie, find out with the link in bio! #backpain #posture #deskjob

Sit down on the floor, then stand up without using your hands. Your ankle, hip and balance need to work together for that, and years of rising only from chairs, sofas and car seats let that combination go quiet. Test your movement age with Previa Health in about two minutes on your phone, free. How many hands do you need? Tell me in the comments. #Mobility #Balance #AnkleMobility #MovementAge #PreviaHealth
